description: AI trading objectives for minitok tossinvest addon. Loaded by runner.js and injected into AI system prompts.
global_objectives: Achieve consistent daily returns above the target engine phase threshold
Maintain drawdown below 3% from high water mark
Diversify across US and JP markets to reduce single-market risk
Continuously evaluate and expand watchlist based on market conditions

US.strategy: Trend-following during ET 09:30-16:00. Pre/post-market gap analysis.
US.notes: No daily price limits. Watch VIX for volatility regime changes.

JP.strategy: USD/JPY correlated plays. BOJ policy sensitive.
JP.notes: TSE +/-22% daily limit. REST-polled only (no WS support).

expansion_criteria.description: Conditions under which the AI should recommend adding new symbols or markets
add_symbol_when: Current watchlist symbols show low volatility or range-bound behavior for >3 sessions
Sector rotation detected away from current holdings
New IPO or earnings catalyst presents asymmetric opportunity
suggest_new_broker_when: All available Toss instruments are fully utilized
Crypto or forex exposure would improve portfolio Sharpe ratio
